name: Morningstar: Book of the fallen
source:
Step into a gritty urban fantasy New York, where Angels hesitate to tread, and the Supernatural entities of Humanity desperately try to hold the line against the forces of the Night.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396740/Morningstar_Book_of_the_Fallen/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
走进一个坚韧不拔的都市奇幻纽约，天使们犹豫着要踏入这里，而人类的超自然实体则拼命地试图坚守阵线，对抗黑夜的力量。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396740/Morningstar_Book_of_the_Fallen/]Steam[/url]]
